```{r}
# Vector of variables of interest
```

## 1. General risk factors

```{r}
general <- read.csv("PATH/list_general_all.csv")
general$Maternal_death <- as.factor(general$Maternal_death)
general$Education_mother_binary <- as.factor(general$Education_mother_binary)
general$Prematurity <- ifelse(general$GA_correct < 37, 1, 0)
general$Prematurity <- as.factor(general$Prematurity)
```

```{r}
regions_select_general <- merge(regions_select,general,by.x="SubjectID",by.y="ID")
```

### 1.1. Prematurity

```{r}
Cohort_PREM <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste0(v, " ~ Prematurity"))
  model <- lm(formula, data = regions_select_general)
  summ <- summary(model)
  
  beta   <- summ$coefficients["Prematurity1", "Estimate"]
  se     <- summ$coefficients["Prematurity1", "Std. Error"]
  t     <- summ$coefficients["Prematurity1", "t value"]
  p      <- summ$coefficients["Prematurity1", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  df_res <- model$df.residual
  
  ci_beta <- confint(model)["Prematurity1", ]
  
  d_res   <- t_to_d(t, df_error = df_res, ci = 0.95)
  
  data.frame(
    Variable   = v,
    Beta       = beta,
    CI_lower   = ci_beta[1],
    CI_upper   = ci_beta[2],
    SE         = se,
    t_value    = t,
    P_value    = p,
    Cohens_d   = d_res$d,
    d_CI_lower = d_res$CI_low,
    d_CI_upper = d_res$CI_high
  )
  
})

Cohort_PREM_df <- do.call(rbind, Cohort_PREM)
Cohort_PREM_df
```

```{r}
regions_select_CIP_treat$treatment_during_preg_CT <- as.factor(regions_select_CIP_treat$treatment_during_preg_CT)
```

```{r}
chemo$Taxanen <- as.factor(chemo$Taxanen)
chemo$Cyclophosphamide <- as.factor(chemo$Cyclophosphamide)
chemo$Anthracyclines <- as.factor(chemo$Anthracyclines)
```

```{r}
# Check
setdiff(treat[treat$treatment_during_preg_CT=="Checked",]$ID,chemo$SubjectID)
```

```{r}
    CI_lower   = ci_beta[1],
    CI_upper   = ci_beta[2],
    SE         = se,
    t_value    = t,
    P_value    = p,
    Cohens_d   = d_res$d,
    d_CI_lower = d_res$CI_low,
    d_CI_upper = d_res$CI_high
  )
})

Chemo_Cyclophosphamide_df <- do.call(rbind, Chemo_Cyclophosphamide)
Chemo_Cyclophosphamide_df
```

### 3.4. Anthracyclines

```{r}
Chemo_Anthracyclines <- lapply(vars, function(v) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste0(v, " ~ Anthracyclines"))
  model <- lm(formula, data = regions_select_CIP_treat_chemo)
  summ <- summary(model)
  
  beta   <- summ$coefficients["Anthracyclines1", "Estimate"]
  se     <- summ$coefficients["Anthracyclines1", "Std. Error"]
  t     <- summ$coefficients["Anthracyclines1", "t value"]
  p      <- summ$coefficients["Anthracyclines1", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  df_res <- model$df.residual
  
  ci_beta <- confint(model)["Anthracyclines1", ]
  
  d_res   <- t_to_d(t, df_error = df_res, ci = 0.95)
  
  data.frame(
    Variable   = v,
    Beta       = beta,
    CI_lower   = ci_beta[1],
    CI_upper   = ci_beta[2],
    SE         = se,
    t_value    = t,
    P_value    = p,
    Cohens_d   = d_res$d,
    d_CI_lower = d_res$CI_low,
    d_CI_upper = d_res$CI_high
  )
})

Chemo_Anthracyclines_df <- do.call(rbind, Chemo_Anthracyclines)
Chemo_Anthracyclines_df
```
